admission.justification: A refresh-capable or expiring credential could expose developer credentials or spoil an expensive trial after launch.

applicability: Hermes GPT eval trials that explicitly admit an access-only openai-codex credential pool.
conditions: The admitted credential expiry must cover the configured trial window and be rechecked before use.
The private CODEX_HOME is empty and ownership/mode checks succeed.
exclusions: Other Hermes arms without this admitted credential.
JWT signature verification or a claim that no external process can ever change the real auth store.

evidence: Frozen tree fd6462b85ba9d06f004e323384ea800f9aa5144a, base 59b01fb8f72a38d2d27f9c37b8b9ca2513fd3fa0; path bindings and source hashes in producer-manifest.json; Reviewer R4 and d229-repairs/report.md.

statement: The hermes-gpt arm installs and rechecks an access-only pool whose expiry covers the trial and whose private empty CODEX_HOME prevents external adoption.
